summary: Slice 2 (Discovery + Intelligence) tested end-to-end against preview URL. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass (candidates list+stats, status/kind filters, watch/promote/dismiss actions with persistence, recommendations shape, decisions shape + verdict/family/min_confidence filters). Frontend: DiscoveryPage renders v2-discovery with stats bar, all filter chips (STATUS + KIND), two-pane list+detail, item click populates detail with WHY/SIGNALS/FIRST SEEN + 3 action buttons; promote action triggers POST, sonner toast fires, and status tag flips to PROMOTED after refetch. Status=NEW filter reduces list to 3 items; DISMISSED+chain filter combo shows the '> 0 candidates match…' empty state. IntelligencePage: /v2/intelligence auto-redirects to /recommendations, sub-nav shows all 7 tabs, Recommendations shows top-routes/top-chains/top-entities panels; Confidence tab shows filter chips + decision-table (7 rows total → 5 after GO → 3 after CEX_ARBITRAGE → 2 after min_conf 70%). Scheduled subs (analytics/certification/market/learning/knowledge) all render the '> {Label} · scheduled for Slice N' hint. Regression: /v2 home and /v2/opportunities still render.

issues: React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' — inside Confidence() the chip() helper returns a <button> and is called from VER.map/FAM.map without providing a key. Cosmetic (console-only), no functional impact. Fix: wrap chip return in a keyed fragment or add key on the button using the label.

action_items: (Optional) Add key prop to Confidence filter chip buttons to silence React warning.
critical_code_review_comments: DiscoveryPage.jsx shadows the global `fetch` by naming its refetch function `fetch`; harmless here (no window.fetch used inside), but slightly confusing — consider renaming to `refetch`.
Backend /api/arbicore/discovery/candidates/{id}/action mutates the module-level _V2_DISCOVERY list — since tests can flip cand-001, keep the reset action documented (already supported).
seed_data_creation: None — used pod-local stubs. Test resets cand-001 and cand-002 back to NEW at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Slice 2 fully green. New backend endpoints: /api/arbicore/discovery/candidates (GET + POST action), /api/arbicore/intelligence/recommendations, /api/arbicore/intelligence/decisions. Frontend routes /v2/discovery and /v2/intelligence/* verified. Only cosmetic React key warning in Confidence filter chips.
